cli.doctor.no_settings: [warn] no settings yet — run: maris3d install
cli.doctor.servers_none: [warn] model servers: none found — serve or install one
cli.error.not_listed: {name} not listed in the release SHA256SUMS
cli.help.express: no prompts: install everything missing automatically (also automatic when stdin is not a terminal, e.g. scripts/CI)
cli.help.gguf: base model file (default: the q8_0 base)
cli.help.lora: the one adapter (default: the shipped one LoRA)
cli.help.model: all = base + one adapter + parts adapter (default), or one file
cli.help.parts: parts adapter (default: the shipped parts LoRA, if installed)
cli.help.source: a folder or URL that holds MANIFEST.json (default: the Hugging Face repo)
cli.help.update: fetch new adapter versions; the base is kept
cli.install.addon_enabled: add-on enabled (3D View > Maris3D Copilot tab)
cli.install.addon_skipped: add-on stage skipped — nothing was changed. Re-run without answering n, or use --express.
cli.install.ask_addon: 1/4 install the Maris3D Copilot add-on into this Blender?
cli.install.ask_download: 3/4 download the model (512 MB, sha-verified: base + adapters) and the llama-server binary (~25 MB) so the copilot runs fully local?
cli.install.ask_use_server: 2/4 a model server is already running ({name}) — use it?
cli.install.done_untested: Install complete (self-test skipped). Open Blender: 3D View > Maris3D Copilot tab in the N-panel.
cli.install.enable_failed: auto-enable failed ({error}) — enable 'Maris3D Copilot' in Blender preferences once.
cli.install.model_skipped: model download skipped — the add-on is installed; run `maris3d install` again when you want the model, or point the copilot at an existing server.
cli.install.no_blender: Blender not found. Set BLENDER_BIN or install Blender 4.2+ (5.2 LTS is the verified version).
cli.install.no_llama: llama-server binary not found and the automatic download failed — install llama.cpp or run: maris3d serve start (see "Ways to run it" on the model card).
cli.install.no_parts: parts adapter not installed ({error}) - planning and editing are unaffected; a thing the library lacks is not designed
cli.install.partial: Partial install — run doctor to see what is missing.
cli.install.product: installing the product: the q8_0 base + the 0.2 adapter (one server).
cli.install.ready: Ready. Open Blender, look for the Maris3D Copilot tab in the 3D View N-panel.
cli.install.selftest_failed: self-test did not report READY — inspect with: maris3d doctor
cli.install.selftest_skipped: self-test skipped — verify later with: maris3d doctor
cli.install.urls_failed: could not set the add-on URLs — set them in the add-on preferences
cli.install.urls_set: add-on pointed at the local server(s)
cli.serve.adapters: adapters loaded: {names} (each turn runs the adapter of its role alone)
cli.serve.exited: llama-server on :{port} exited at startup — see {log}
cli.serve.no_binary: no llama-server binary — run: maris3d install (or install llama.cpp)
cli.serve.no_one_loaded: the one adapter is not loaded on this server - the copilot has no model to ask
cli.serve.one_server: one server, 512 MB: {model} + {adapter}; each request names its role and runs that adapter alone
cli.serve.parts_missing: parts adapter not found - serving without it (a thing the library lacks is not designed)
cli.serve.slow: slow start on :{port}; still booting — check maris3d serve status
cli.update.partial: not everything was installed; what was there before keeps serving
cli.update.report: release {release}: kept {kept}, fetched {fetched}, removed {removed}, {bytes:,} bytes transferred
cli.update.restart: restart the server to load the new files: maris3d serve stop && maris3d serve start
error.edit_unreadable: the edit answer cannot be read
note.parts.refused: {noun}: the parts planner's answer cannot be built ({why}); {instead}
result.edit_passes: I could not settle this change in {passes} passes; say it with the thing's name.
result.no_plan_built: I could not turn that into things to build; nothing was added. Try naming the things, like "a bench and a lamp".
result.server_unreachable: The model server did not answer, so nothing was built: {error}
result.which_thing: I could not tell which thing you mean; say it with the thing's name.
say.code.from_library: from the library, not designed by the model: {names}
say.code.skips: skips what it has no recipe for: {names}
say.edit.asked: asked in words about the things in the scene
say.router.edit: a change to what the scene has: the edit model
say.router.edit_fell_through: the edit model changed nothing: trying the finish and the planner
say.router.exact_edit: an exact instruction with numbers: the edit model copies them
